requirements.statement: Update with a child running proceeds; lost settlement, retained committed custody and phase recovery; all other preflight refusals write nothing.
No idle wait or manual stop for a verified predecessor.
Committed results and open/paused orchestrations stay recordable under current authority.
Proven predecessor exit before adoption; lifetime lock and epoch fence; schema and version floor prevent reopen.
Updated project's running children end lost; other work follows D2.5 and other projects survive.
One recording or settlement effect per binding across versions and retries.
Primary recheck remains idempotent across takeover.
Existing B4m commands and documented installed-old-client refusals remain accurate.
Status names each takeover outcome using D2.8 wording without changing existing reply shapes.
Unknown lineage or corrupt custody is refused and held, never guessed or freed.
Every named phase resumes with one effect, including internal migration and atomic-file crash cuts.
